name: Tsumi no Hikari Rendezvous
source:
In front of the lone tunnel leading out from the small village of Tamasato, [url=/c36919]Yuuto[/url] draws a picture of a mermaid living in the deep ocean where light does not reach. One day, he looked up from his drawing and there was a girl in front of him who looked just like the one on his canvas. She called herself a ‘sinner’ who came to this town to repent for her sins. Yuuto and the townspeople welcomed the girl, [url=/c36908]Ai[/url], to their town.

Come spring, the entrance ceremony was underway. The new students took pictures and videos in front of the school with their parents to commemorate this special day. However, it was a depressing event for Yuuto, who lives alone after the death of his father and the abandonment by his mother and older sister. While he had gotten used to it, this time he suddenly felt very lonely due to the recent passing of grandmother, the sole close relative he had left.

Upon finding out about Yuuto’s loneliness, Ai confided that she was abandoned by her parents. She searched for a reason for living, whereas he ran away from reality through his imaginative drawings. Even though they were polar opposites, their backgrounds also made them quite similar. Gradually, they became closer to each other, while harbouring secrets of their own.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/02/06/february-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在玉里村唯一一条通往外界的隧道前，[url=/c36919]勇人[/url]画着一条生活在深海、阳光无法抵达之处的人鱼。某天，他从画上抬起头，发现面前站着一个和画中人鱼一模一样的女孩。她自称“罪人”，来到这个小镇是为了赎罪。勇人和村民们欢迎女孩[url=/c36908]爱[/url]来到村子。

春天来临，入学典礼开始了。新生和父母在学校前拍照、录像，纪念这个特别的日子。然而，对独自生活的勇人来说，这是一场令人沮丧的活动。他的父亲已经去世，母亲和姐姐也抛弃了他。虽然他早已习惯独处，但这一次，唯一亲近的亲人——祖母最近去世，更让他感到孤独。

爱得知勇人的孤独后，告诉他自己也被父母抛弃。她一直寻找活下去的理由，而勇人则通过想象中的画作逃避现实。两人的经历截然相反，却又因为相似的身世而彼此理解。他们逐渐靠近，同时各自怀抱着秘密。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/02/06/february-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
